props.name: getRowId
props.description: Stable row ids keep selection and expansion attached to the right rows. Defaults to the index path.

props.name: getSubRows
props.description: Turns the table into a tree: rows with children get an expand toggle in the first column.

props.name: search
props.description: Search box that matches any column.

props.name: selectable
props.description: Leading checkbox column with select-all in the header.

props.name: bulkActions
props.description: Menu shown in the toolbar while rows are selected.

props.name: viewOptions
props.description: Toolbar View popover: density plus a checkbox per hideable column.

props.name: resizable
props.description: Drag the right edge of a header to resize; double-click it to reset.

props.name: reorderable
props.description: Drag headers by their grip to reorder columns.

props.name: pinnable
props.description: Column menu entries to pin a column to the start or end.

props.name: exportable
props.description: Export the filtered and sorted rows (every page) from the toolbar.

props.name: onCellEdit
props.description: Makes columns with `meta.editable` editable; update `data` to keep the change.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Height at which the body scrolls under a sticky header.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Extra toolbar content after the built-in controls.
